chunks: He was asked about a house in which plaster had been prepared with dung: is it permissible for the mosque to be plastered with it?
So he said: “There is no harm.”

key_terms.الْمَسْجِدُ: the mosque, the place of worship
key_terms.بِالْعَذِرَةِ: with dung used in the preparation process
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection in doing so

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to plaster a mosque with plaster prepared using dung?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that there is no objection to using plaster prepared with dung for plastering a mosque. Its significance is in clarifying a ruling related to ritual purity and the maintenance of mosques.
